title: 手持ちアングルグラインダー
description: 金属保守作業台に横置きする携帯研削工具。長いモーター胴、後方握り、横の補助ハンドル、直角ギア部、固定研削円盤と締付フランジ、作業側を開けた半周ガード、通気部とスイッチを造形。据置両頭グラインダーとは異なる手持ち姿勢です。円盤・補助握りを含む一式1点で、回転・研削・電装・ガード調整は実装せず、保護性能や実用品安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.260 × 0.133 × 0.441 m、7,164三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A portable grinding-tool prop resting on a maintenance bench, with long motor body, rear grip, side auxiliary handle, right-angle gear head, fixed abrasive wheel and clamping flange, half-wrap guard exposing the working side, vents and switch. It differs from a stationary double-wheel bench grinder. Disc and auxiliary grip belong to one assembly. Rotation, grinding, electrical operation and guard adjustment are absent; protective performance and real tool safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.260 × 0.133 × 0.441 m; 7,164 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
